behaviour: No registration type is preselected; the fields and options appear after a type is chosen. Switching type keeps the shared fields (first name, last name, email).

Options are shown per category in the order workshop, event, meal, other, filtered to those whose availableTo includes the chosen type; a category with no option for the type is not shown (AC-003-01..03).
On submit the form validates every field with the rules of RegistrationRequest in openapi.yaml; if any fails it shows each error in error-<field> and sends nothing (NFR-03).
A 400 or 409 response with fieldErrors shows each message in error-<field> (unknown field names go to form-error); the entered values stay (AC-004-02).
Any other error shows a generic message in form-error and no confirmation (AC-004-03).
A 201 response replaces the form with the confirmation (BR-06).
Each input has a visible label linked to it; each error element is linked with aria-describedby and has role=alert.
The submit button is disabled while a request is in progress.
